text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ ٱلْبَسْطِ فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُومًۭا مَّحْسُورًا

words.gloss_range: coordinating continuation that links this hand-discipline command to the surrounding ethical sequence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes 17:29 a continuation, not a detached maxim. It carries the reader from the preceding speech-and-means guidance into a bodily giving command, so hand discipline remains part of the same Surah 17 ethical chain. The compressed opening lets continuation and prohibition arrive together at the first sound.

topics.headline: continuative coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah begin as a linked continuation of the prior injunctions rather than as a fresh isolated rule.
topics.reason: The conjunction is locally coordinating and joins this command to the preceding ethical discourse.

topics.headline: continuity across scene shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a shift from speech management to hand posture still belongs to one ethical sequence.
topics.reason: The connective has semantic force because it bridges the 17:28 speech setting into the 17:29 giving-hand setting.

topics.headline: compressed wa-la opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears continuation and prohibition arrive together at the first sound of the ayah.
topics.reason: The surface sequence joins the conjunction to the following prohibitive particle in the opening recitation unit.

topics.headline: boundary bridge from 17:28
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 17:28 conditioned speech under need leads directly into 17:29 unconditional regulation of giving.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence links the prior eased-speech response to this hand-discipline prohibition.

topics.headline: continued command chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads the verse as another member of the larger command chain that begins earlier in the Surah 17 ethical block.
topics.reason: The structural rows make the opening conjunction launch another unit in the ongoing injunction series.

words.gloss_range: first prohibitive particle governing a jussive verb and opening the restraint pole

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: jussive verb governed by the first prohibitive particle

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is the first explicit prohibition. It governs {{ar:تَجْعَلْ}} ({{tr:tajʿal}}) as a jussive command, so the chained-hand image is not merely described; making that state is forbidden. Because the particle remains separate before the verb, negation and action stay distinct, and no vocative is needed for responsibility; mood and person marking do the address. The repeated {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) later builds a neither-nor frame.

topics.headline: prohibitive particle over jussive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the hand image as a binding negative command, not a neutral description.
topics.reason: The particle is prohibitive and governs the jussive verb that follows.

topics.headline: negation as forbidding act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle performs prohibition, not just semantic negation.
topics.reason: The particle blocks the making of the chained-hand state through the grammar of direct address.

topics.headline: separate particle scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can keep negation and action distinct because the particle visibly scopes over the following verb.
topics.reason: The particle remains separate before the jussive verb rather than being absorbed into the verb form.

topics.headline: directive force without vocative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that direct responsibility is created by mood and person marking even without a vocative.
topics.reason: The prohibitive construction supplies address through grammar alone.

topics.headline: first half of neither-nor frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first restraint extreme as only one side of a balanced double prohibition.
topics.reason: The first negative clause is answered by the second negative clause and then by the shared result.

words.gloss_range: make, place, or render into a state; locally a prohibited second-person jussive that creates a hand-plus-state configuration
words.root_gloss_range: broad making, placing, rendering, and initiating field; local grammar selects caused configuration and spatial placing toward the neck

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: owned hand configured by the making verb
resultant chained state governed as the second object

words.prose: {{ar:تَجْعَلْ}} ({{tr:tajʿal}}) makes the restraint image an act the addressee would cause. Its two-object frame configures {{ar:يَدَكَ}} ({{tr:yadaka}}) as the thing acted on and {{ar:مَغْلُولَةً}} ({{tr:maghlūlatan}}) as the produced state; the root range keeps making, rendering, and placing pressure alive, while the jussive prohibition fixes the local force as a barred self-configuration assigned to the singular addressee. The same make-to-result pattern recalls Surah 17 consequence templates (17:22; 17:39).

topics.headline: two-object causative frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees miserliness as a produced configuration of the hand, not as a merely described condition.
topics.reason: The verb governs the hand and the chained participle as two accusative complements.

topics.headline: make-place-render range locally narrowed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that making and placing both press on the image: the hand is rendered into a state and spatially set toward the neck.
topics.reason: The broad root range survives as local coloring, but the construction selects caused configuration rather than every branch of the root.

topics.headline: second-person jussive responsibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees direct responsibility assigned to one addressee through the jussive second-person form.
topics.reason: The form is a second masculine singular imperfect jussive governed by the prohibitive particle.

topics.headline: Surah 17 make-to-sit template
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this prohibition-consequence movement belongs to a repeated Surah 17 pattern (17:22; 17:39).
topics.reason: The rows identify a same-surah template in which making is followed by a consequence state.

topics.headline: first image staged by the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the chained hand as a staged moral scene created by the first main verb.
topics.reason: The verb opens the ayah core and anchors the first image before the second prohibition balances it.

words.gloss_range: your hand as concrete body part and metonym for giving capacity, power, reach, and agency
words.root_gloss_range: hand, power, favor, capacity, and reach; locally the concrete possessed hand remains primary while giving capacity is activated by context

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later suffixed verb that resumes the same hand as object

words.prose: {{ar:يَدَكَ}} ({{tr:yadaka}}) is the owned hand that the addressee must not misconfigure. The suffix makes the instrument personally accountable, while the broader hand field lets the concrete limb stand for giving capacity and agency. The word order shows the giving instrument first, before the chained state and neck endpoint close around it. The same hand is later resumed by the object suffix in {{ar:تَبْسُطْهَا}} ({{tr:tabsuṭhā}}), so the ayah balances two treatments of one instrument.

topics.headline: first object with owned suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the hand as the patient of the addressee’s own action and as personally owned.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the first object and carries the second-person suffix.

topics.headline: hand as giving capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the concrete hand also carries giving capacity, power, and reach without losing its bodily image.
topics.reason: The root range supports power and favor, but local grammar keeps a singular concrete hand as the anchor.

topics.headline: singular possessed concreteness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ethical capacity built from one concrete possessed body part rather than from an abstract term.
topics.reason: The singular concrete possessed form resists dissolving the word into pure abstraction.

topics.headline: one hand through both extremes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same hand moves from chained restraint to total extension, making the two prohibitions directly comparable.
topics.reason: The pronoun in the second verb refers back to this hand, and the rows also connect the imagery to 5:64.

topics.headline: hand foregrounded before constraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the giving instrument first, before the chained state and neck endpoint close around it.
topics.reason: The word order advances the hand before naming what happens to it.

words.gloss_range: chained, shackled, bound; locally the produced passive state of the hand in the restraint pole
words.root_gloss_range: binding, shackling, rancor, and misappropriation field; local grammar selects physical binding while withholding and distrust color the giving context

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: feminine hand that the participle agrees with

words.prose: {{ar:مَغْلُولَةً}} ({{tr:maghlūlatan}}) names the state into which the hand is rendered. As a feminine passive participle it agrees with {{ar:يَدَكَ}} ({{tr:yadaka}}), not the neck, and it supplies the restraint pole that will be answered by full extension. The doubled liquid sound lets the binding word linger acoustically. The shackle-root is concrete here, but in a giving context its wider field of withholding and hidden breach adds pressure without replacing the local image; the chain-extension polarity also has a hand-image counterpart at 5:64.

topics.headline: second object resultant state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the chained condition as the result complement produced by the prohibited making.
topics.reason: The accusative passive participle functions as the second object of the verb.

topics.headline: shackling with withholding pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices physical binding first, with the broader root field making the restraint morally charged as withheld benefit.
topics.reason: The local form selects shackling, while the root’s rancor and misappropriation branches remain contextual pressure only.

topics.headline: passive feminine participle on the hand
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the hand as acted upon and locked into a state, with agreement fixing the state to the hand.
topics.reason: The passive participle is feminine singular accusative because it modifies the grammatically feminine hand.

topics.headline: chain-extension polarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the chained state belongs to a polarity also visible in the hand imagery of 5:64.
topics.reason: The evidence links the shackle root and extension root in a cross-passage contrast while local human conduct remains the focus.

topics.headline: pivot toward neck endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the participle bridge the acted-on hand to the endpoint phrase that completes the first image.
topics.reason: The word stands between the hand and the prepositional phrase that specifies where the hand is chained.

words.gloss_range: preposition of direction, limit, and endpoint; locally marks the neck as the terminus of the restraint

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: neck endpoint governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) gives the chain image a direction and endpoint. The hand is not merely restrained somewhere; it is drawn toward {{ar:عُنُقِكَ}} ({{tr:ʿunuqika}}), making the restraint self-enclosing and severe. The endpoint can be felt with both the act of making and the resulting bound state, so the first image remains incomplete until this phrase arrives.

topics.headline: endpoint governor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the neck as the governed endpoint of the chained-hand phrase.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the genitive neck and marks a terminus for the constraint.

topics.headline: directional limit, not static location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hand as pulled toward a limit rather than simply located in restraint.
topics.reason: The endpoint sense gives the image directional force.

topics.headline: endpoint narrows the binding image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the metaphor is not loose restraint but a specific self-enclosing hand-to-neck configuration.
topics.reason: The preposition restricts the chained state to the neck endpoint.

topics.headline: prepositional phrase completes image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first image remains incomplete until this endpoint phrase arrives.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase follows the chained participle and completes the spatial architecture.

words.gloss_range: your neck as concrete endpoint, burden locus, and chokepoint of self-directed constraint
words.root_gloss_range: neck, forepart, group, burden, vulnerability, and constraint field; locally the possessed concrete neck is primary

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition governing the neck as endpoint

words.prose: {{ar:عُنُقِكَ}} ({{tr:ʿunuqika}}) closes the first prohibition at the addressee’s own neck. Its genitive case makes it the endpoint governed by {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}), and the suffix binds it to the same person whose hand was named. The rare neck field gives the image a burden-and-chokepoint force, while the heavy onset and qāf closure suit the bodily chokepoint. A same-surah resonance appears in the neck-fate image (17:13).

topics.headline: genitive possessed endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the neck as the governed endpoint of the chain and as the addressee’s own body part.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the preposition and carries the second-person suffix.

topics.headline: neck as burden chokepoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the concrete neck is also a vulnerability and burden locus, intensifying the self-restraint image.
topics.reason: The root field supports burden and constraint, while local grammar keeps the physical neck primary.

topics.headline: singular owned body locus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one intimate body system: your hand fastened to your own neck.
topics.reason: The singular possessed form prevents the neck from becoming a generic symbol.

topics.headline: same-surah neck motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a same-surah binding motif where the neck carries moral consequence (17:13).
topics.reason: The evidence connects this neck image with the earlier Surah 17 neck-fate image.

topics.headline: first pole sealed at the neck
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the restraint pole close at a body chokepoint before the second prohibition opens.
topics.reason: The word is the final word of the first prohibition.

words.gloss_range: intra-ayah conjunction coordinating the second prohibition with the first as a parallel opposite
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) starts the second prohibition as a coordinated partner, not a loose next item. It joins the chained-hand pole to the extension pole while keeping each clause independently forbidden. The repeated wa-la onset makes the second negative command echo the opening frame audibly.

topics.headline: coordination of matched clauses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second prohibition as grammatically parallel to the first.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second negative clause with the first.

topics.headline: balance relation between poles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction helps create balance, not mere sequence.
topics.reason: The connector pairs opposite treatments of the same hand.

topics.headline: second wa-la frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second negative command echo the opening frame.
topics.reason: The conjunction is surface-bound to the following prohibitive particle in a repeated frame.

topics.headline: two prohibitions without collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the two extremes linked but not merged, so both remain independently rejected.
topics.reason: The conjunction creates pairing while preserving two clauses.

words.gloss_range: second prohibitive particle governing the jussive extension verb and completing the neither-nor frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: suffixed verb governed by the second prohibitive particle

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) gives the extension pole the same prohibitive force as the chained-hand pole. It governs {{ar:تَبْسُطْهَا}} ({{tr:tabsuṭhā}}), so total extension is rejected as mismeasure, and the attached object pronoun remains inside the prohibition’s scope. The two {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) particles make the middle path implied rather than named, with parallel cadence balancing the different verb sounds.

topics.headline: second prohibitive over jussive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees overextension as equally forbidden, not as a lesser warning.
topics.reason: The second prohibitive particle governs the jussive extension verb.

topics.headline: negation of total measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that total extension is not praised as generosity but rejected as excess.
topics.reason: The negation scopes over the verb and its totalizing measure phrase.

topics.headline: separate negator scopes over suffixed verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the attached object pronoun remain inside the prohibition’s scope.
topics.reason: The particle stands separately before the suffixed verb.

topics.headline: neither-nor middle implied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader infers the balanced middle because both extremes are named and negated.
topics.reason: The second negative clause completes the binary frame.

words.gloss_range: extend or spread it; locally a prohibited direct hand-extension verb with the hand carried by the feminine object suffix
words.root_gloss_range: spreading, extending, opening the hand, amplitude, and gladdening; locally physical extension and giving-distribution are selected under a prohibition of total extent

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: totalizing cognate-object phrase that completes the extension scale

words.prose: {{ar:تَبْسُطْهَا}} ({{tr:tabsuṭhā}}) carries the same hand into the second clause through its object suffix. The verb names direct Form I extension, and the giving context makes that physical movement a figure for resource distribution. Its force is incomplete until {{ar:كُلَّ ٱلْبَسْطِ}} ({{tr:kulla al-basṭi}}) turns extension into total overextension. The accepted emphatic-ṣād variant thickens the same extension verb without changing its object or parse, and the next ayah reuses the same root for measured divine provision (17:30).

topics.headline: suffixed object under jussive prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same hand directly governed by the second prohibited action.
topics.reason: The verb is jussive under the second prohibitive particle and carries the object suffix referring to the hand.

topics.headline: extension as giving-distribution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that spreading the hand means open-handed giving here, while the concrete hand motion still controls the metaphor.
topics.reason: The root range includes spreading, expansion, and giving, but the local object suffix keeps the concrete hand active.

topics.headline: direct Form I and qiraat sound pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both the directness of the Form I action and the recitational heaviness of the accepted emphatic variant without changing the local parse.
topics.reason: The Form I verb is direct extension; the sīn-to-ṣād variant affects sound texture rather than referent or syntax.

topics.headline: forward provision contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees human total extension immediately contrasted with calibrated divine extension in the next ayah (17:30).
topics.reason: The same root recurs in the next ayah in the provision field.

topics.headline: second pole opens scale phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second extreme begin at the verb and reach its limit only in the following totality phrase.
topics.reason: The verb launches a scale completed by the cognate object.

words.gloss_range: all, whole, total; locally the accusative totalizer that measures the extent of extension
words.root_gloss_range: whole, entire, all, each, and totality; locally collective total extent of one action, not distributive eachness
words.prose: {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) is the word that makes the second prohibition maximal. In the cognate-object construction it does not name what is given; it measures how far the extending goes and waits for the process noun that completes it: the whole extension. That totality is the problem, turning generosity into an unbounded measure. The common totality word becomes locally marked because it occupies this rare measure slot in a distribution context.

topics.headline: accusative cognate-object measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees totality functioning as a syntactic measure of the verb, not as a separate object.
topics.reason: The word is accusative in the absolute-object phrase modifying the extension verb.

topics.headline: totality as forbidden excess
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that all-ness is locally negative because it marks overextension without remainder.
topics.reason: The totality field is selected as collective full extent of one action.

topics.headline: construct totalizer awaits target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the totalizing word demand the process noun that completes it.
topics.reason: The totalizer governs the definite verbal noun that follows.

topics.headline: totality within provision distribution field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a common totality word become marked by its rare local measure slot in a distribution context.
topics.reason: The rows connect the root to Surah 17 totality vocabulary and provision-distribution contexts.

topics.headline: pivot from action to absolute scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a simple act of extending become an absolute scale at this word.
topics.reason: Placed between verb and process noun, the word turns the action into a maximal measure.

words.gloss_range: the extending or spreading; locally the definite gerund measured by the totalizer in a cognate-object construction
words.root_gloss_range: spreading, extension, amplitude, open-handedness, and provision; locally a definite verbal noun naming the process measured to excess

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: totalizer governing the gerund as its process target

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَسْطِ}} ({{tr:al-basṭi}}) completes the phrase that measures the forbidden extension. As a definite gerund governed by {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}), it names the process of extending itself, so the verb is measured by its own noun. The marked definite process noun also seals the excess beat before the result clause begins. The accepted emphatic variant adds sound weight without shifting the construction. The local root echo makes overextension self-reflexive, and the next ayah’s root reprise redirects extension toward divine provision (17:30).

topics.headline: genitive gerund inside absolute object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees nested grammar: genitive under the totalizer, but serving the verb’s absolute measure.
topics.reason: The gerund is genitive after the totalizer inside the cognate-object construction.

topics.headline: process noun for extension and giving
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun measures both physical extension and open-handed giving without becoming an abstract generosity slogan.
topics.reason: The root range includes extension and generosity, but the local maṣdar names the measured process of the verb.

topics.headline: definite maṣdar and variant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a marked definite process noun, with the accepted emphatic variant adding sound weight rather than changing the syntax.
topics.reason: The form is definite and genitive; the variant changes consonantal texture while preserving the construction.

topics.headline: root echo and 17:30 reprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action is repeated as its own noun here, then redirected in the next ayah (17:30).
topics.reason: The verb and maṣdar share the same root, and the root recurs in the following provision verse.

topics.headline: excess beat sealed before consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second prohibition land at maximum extension just before the result clause begins.
topics.reason: This word closes the second prohibition before the causal particle.

words.gloss_range: resultative particle that turns the prior two prohibitions into one consequence clause
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the turn into consequence. It does not merely say then; it gathers both forbidden extremes into one result, so chained restraint and total extension both lead toward the same seated state of blame and depletion. As a proclitic it clings directly to the sitting verb, making the causal turn immediate. The boundary contrast with the right speech-response in 17:28 sharpens the move from proper response to bad consequence-state.

topics.headline: result particle governing consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final clause as the result of the preceding extremes, not as a third independent command.
topics.reason: The particle is resultative and introduces the subjunctive consequence verb.

topics.headline: causal not merely sequential
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sitting state is grammatically produced by mismanaged giving.
topics.reason: The particle has causal-result force in this construction.

topics.headline: proclitic attached to result verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the causal turn cling directly to the verb of sitting.
topics.reason: The particle is written and recited with the following verb.

topics.headline: boundary contrast with 17:28
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between the proper response particle in 17:28 and the bad-result particle here.
topics.reason: The boundary evidence contrasts 17:28 speech response with 17:29 threatened stasis.

topics.headline: two extremes converge into one outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees opposite prohibitions distributed into a single shared verdict.
topics.reason: The single result particle follows both prohibitions and scopes over the consequence clause.

words.gloss_range: sit, remain, be left in place; locally an avoidable subjunctive result-state after the causal particle
words.root_gloss_range: sitting, remaining, abstaining, idleness, station, and being left behind; locally helpless remaining-in-place under blame and depletion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: resultative particle governing the subjunctive consequence verb

words.prose: {{ar:تَقْعُدَ}} ({{tr:taqʿuda}}) changes the addressee from actor to affected sitter. The subjunctive after {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) marks an avoidable result, and the same unspoken second-person subject carries through from making and extending into bearing the outcome. The imperfect/subjunctive form presents this not as a completed fall but as a state one may come to inhabit. The root field lets the result be more than posture: the person is left in immobilized stasis, qualified by the two final circumstantial states. A same-surah pattern appears with the altered consequence pair in 17:22.

topics.headline: subjunctive result with same subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sitting as an avoidable consequence borne by the same addressee who acted earlier.
topics.reason: The verb is subjunctive after the causal particle and has the same implicit second-person subject.

topics.headline: sitting as helpless remaining
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the result is immobilized stasis, not merely neutral physical sitting.
topics.reason: The root range includes sitting and remaining; local consequence grammar selects helpless remaining in place.

topics.headline: fused causal verb and ongoing state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the result as a state one may come to inhabit rather than a completed fall.
topics.reason: The imperfect/subjunctive form and attached particle present the consequence as potential inhabited state.

topics.headline: 17:22 consequence pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 17:29 varies an earlier Surah 17 consequence pattern with a different pair of final states (17:22).
topics.reason: The evidence links this verb and consequence structure to 17:22.

topics.headline: pivot from action to state cluster
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah shift from managing actions to inhabiting the final blamed-and-depleted state.
topics.reason: The verb opens the closing state cluster governed by two circumstantial accusatives.

words.gloss_range: blamed, reproached, censured; locally the first passive circumstantial state of the seated addressee
words.root_gloss_range: blame, censure, reproach, and self-reproach; locally received blame is primary with possible internalized censure as secondary pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second paired circumstantial state after blame

words.prose: {{ar:مَلُومًۭا}} ({{tr:malūman}}) is not an object of sitting; it is the first circumstantial state in which the addressee ends up. Its passive participle form makes blame received, and its masculine agreement attaches that blame to the hidden addressee rather than to the feminine hand. Its indefinite tanwīn leaves the blame qualitative and open while matching the cadence of {{ar:مَّحْسُورًا}} ({{tr:maḥsūran}}). Placed before that second state, it makes censure the first half of the closing verdict, with same-surah recurrence at 17:39 and a root-family pressure from self-reproach at 75:2.

topics.headline: first circumstantial passive state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees blame as the state in which the addressee sits, not as an object acted upon.
topics.reason: The word is an accusative circumstantial passive participle after the sitting verb.

topics.headline: received censure with internal pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the result is morally evaluative blame, primarily received but capable of turning inward.
topics.reason: The root field supports blame and self-reproach, while the local passive participle selects received censure.

topics.headline: indefinite passive participle agreement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the blame-state attached to the masculine addressee and left qualitatively open.
topics.reason: The masculine singular indefinite accusative form agrees with the hidden subject.

topics.headline: Surah 17 shame marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this blame word recurs as a closure marker with a different twin in 17:39.
topics.reason: The same form appears later in the surah with another paired outcome.

topics.headline: first half of paired verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the result move first through censure and then into depletion.
topics.reason: The word begins the two-part final predicate and shares cadence with the next participle.

words.gloss_range: depleted, exhausted, stripped, exposed, regretful; locally the second passive circumstantial state and final closure word
words.root_gloss_range: uncovering, stripping, exhaustion, regret, and depletion; locally resource-loss, exposure, and drained capacity converge after total extension
words.prose: {{ar:مَّحْسُورًا}} ({{tr:maḥsūran}}) completes the final state pair. It is another accusative passive participle tied to the same seated addressee, but its root field adds stripped capacity, exhaustion, exposure, and regret to the preceding blame. As the final word and a distinctive passive-participle closure, it lets the ayah end not with the act of giving but with the person left depleted. Its matching tanwīn cadence seals blame and depletion as a social-personal double verdict; the same root also resonates with loss in 17:8 and wearied return in 67:4, while 17:28’s eased wording contrasts with this depleted ending.

topics.headline: second circumstantial state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees depletion co-present with blame as the second state of the seated addressee.
topics.reason: The word is a coordinated accusative circumstantial passive participle.

topics.headline: depletion, exposure, and exhaustion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the result is not only poverty but stripped, exhausted, exposed capacity.
topics.reason: The root field includes uncovering, fatigue, regret, and depletion; local context selects depleted capacity with exposure-to-blame pressure.

topics.headline: passive participle closure and rarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the addressee as acted upon by the outcome, with a specially marked final form.
topics.reason: The passive participle form makes depletion an affected state, and the rows mark the local closure form as distinctive.

topics.headline: loss-field and boundary contrasts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final depletion links to Surah 17 loss language (17:8), wearied return imagery (67:4), and the prior eased word in 17:28.
topics.reason: The evidence gives same-root and boundary contrasts that sharpen the final word.

topics.headline: final social-personal verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears blame and depletion seal the ayah as one double-state verdict.
topics.reason: The word lands last and pairs in case, form, and cadence with the preceding participle.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from the hand bound to the neck through total extension to sitting blamed and exhausted.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hand combines controlled resources with the capacity to transfer them. Binding blocks deployment, while total release consumes the reserve; the causal result converts a one-time quantity choice into loss of future agency.

activation_trace.role: The owning and disposing hand supplies both the resources under control and the agency that deploys them.
A restraint fixed around an organ makes withholding an active disabling of the means of transfer.
Releasing and extending the hand supplies the opposite pole: capacity is put fully into circulation.
Total enclosure of all parts removes any remainder and turns generosity into exhaustive deployment.
Inability to rise renders the result as disabled future action rather than neutral sitting.
Deserved reproach adds a social audit to the material failure.
Spent strength and exhausted stock identify the terminal state produced by release without reserve.

changed_reading.before: A warning to be neither stingy nor extravagant.
changed_reading.after: A design for preserving actionable capacity: resources must circulate, but no transfer may consume the ability to answer the next claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reflexive body picture of your hand, your neck, full extension, and the actor left sitting exposed to blame.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse stages two bodily postures that feed back upon their agent. Self-binding contracts the field of relation; indiscriminate extension removes cover and motion, so the body that tried to reach without limit becomes static, vulnerable, and publicly answerable.

activation_trace.role: The beneficent hand makes outward relation and favor the bodily capacity at stake.
The collaring restraint literalizes a posture in which the actor binds outward beneficence back onto the self.
The neck as the body part receiving the restraint closes the withholding posture into a self-directed loop.
Spreading against contraction supplies a body opened without boundary.
Fixed sitting is the bodily reversal of the prior attempt at unlimited reach.
Being bare of protection makes depletion also an exposure, not merely an empty balance.

changed_reading.before: The verse judges two spending totals.
changed_reading.after: The verse diagnoses how repeated postures remake the actor: closure constricts relation, while boundaryless exposure returns as immobility and loss of protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding commands distinguish a material channel from enduring relational channels. Care is enacted through beneficence, a lowered protective side, mercy, and accessible speech; therefore a hand unable to transfer at one moment need not become a person closed to the claimant.

activation_trace.role: The restrained organ anchors the revised question: whether material limitation has become relational closure.
Beneficent action makes care an enacted obligation rather than a feeling measured only by expenditure.
The wing as side, hand, and shelter supplies a second bodily instrument for protective relation.
Gentle pliancy without humiliation defines a non-dominating posture between hard refusal and self-erasure.
Tender mercy supplies the motive that keeps care active when material action is bounded.
Turning one's side away names a temporary failure of the material channel that could harden into withdrawal.
Spoken address keeps the claimant within relation when the hand cannot presently give.
Ease after difficulty makes gracious speech a bridge through constrained circumstances.

structural_cues: 17:23-24 choreograph care through speech and a lowered body before 17:29 choreographs the hand.
17:28 immediately precedes the focus and supplies easy speech when material response is deferred.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies embodied care, a turned-away material posture, and compensating speech; I infer that inability and withholding are separated by whether relation remains open. A live alternative is that 17:28 teaches courtesy independently of the focus verse's resource limit.

changed_reading.before: A closed hand and an empty hand are opposite financial errors.
changed_reading.after: Material inability is not itself the bound-hand error; the error becomes closure when mercy, acknowledgment, and speech are also withdrawn.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence orders circulation before restraint: transfer what is due to named claimants, then prevent wealth from being scattered beyond purpose. Reserve is legitimate only after rights have been recognized; anti-waste cannot be used to rename nonpayment as prudence.

activation_trace.role: The hand of direct transfer anchors the focus in an actual movement from holder to recipient.
Concrete giving establishes positive release as the first operation, not a concession after saving.
A right owned by its claimant converts some outgoing wealth from optional generosity into discharge of another's due.
Money dispersed in excess supplies the distinct failure that consumes capacity after rightful transfer is secured.

structural_cues: 17:26 places affirmative giving and a claimant's right before the paired prohibition on dispersal.
17:27 intensifies the warning against dispersal before 17:29 restates the two-ended hand discipline.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies giving, an owned right, and waste as dispersal; I infer an ordering rule: satisfy claims, then preserve capacity. The live alternative is a less ordered, general warning against both stinginess and extravagance.

changed_reading.before: Moderation means choosing a middle amount that protects the giver.
changed_reading.after: Moderation is fiduciary sequencing: release what belongs to claimants, but do not scatter the remainder so completely that future claims become impossible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate repetition of extension in relation to provision, paired with measured constriction, replaces a fixed midpoint with responsive calibration. The permitted span changes with actual allotment; the invariant is preservation of responsible agency.

activation_trace.role: Full breadth and increase anchor the dangerous human attempt to turn current capacity into total outflow.
Expansion of provision relocates breadth within a variable supply rather than an autonomous human maximum.
An allotted gift supplies the changing resource envelope within which the hand acts.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the counter-cycle that any sustainable practice must survive.

structural_cues: 17:30 immediately repeats ب س ط after the focus, now with provision as its object.
Expansion and constriction are coordinated in one clause rather than assigned fixed moral values.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies variable expansion, allotted provision, and constriction; I infer that human restraint should track changing capacity rather than enforce a constant numerical midpoint. A live alternative is that 17:30 explains unequal means without prescribing a method of calibration.

changed_reading.before: The safe choice is always the same moderate fraction.
changed_reading.after: The safe rule is dynamic: release can widen or narrow with provision, but it must never become either permanent paralysis or exhaustive outflow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next prohibition exposes fear as a dangerous controller of allocation. Anticipated empty-handedness can drive a holder to erase future claimants; the focus therefore regulates not only amounts but the panic loop by which fear of depletion produces destructive closure.

activation_trace.role: The self-imposed restraint anchors the defensive closure that scarcity fear can harden.
Fear mixed with awe supplies the anticipatory pressure acting before the feared shortage is present.
A hand stripped of money until need gives the fear a direct empty-hand image contiguous with the focus.
Taking life marks the terminal social consequence when allocation panic decides which claimant may remain.
Allotted provision interrupts the assumption that the fearful holder is the sole source of every future share.

structural_cues: 17:31 follows the focus and names fear of destitution as a motive for eliminating dependents.
The provision statement answers the fear between the prohibition and its judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear, the image of a hand emptied of wealth, killing, and provision; I infer that fear of depletion can turn reserve into life-denying closure. The live alternative is the narrower reading of 17:31 as a direct ban without feedback into 17:29.

changed_reading.before: The bound hand is simply a miserly preference.
changed_reading.after: The bound hand can be a panic response: imagined scarcity monopolizes control, hardens against dependents, and must be interrupted by a wider account of provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later case grants real authority for a recognized wrong and immediately bars excess. This activates the hand as power: legitimate capacity must not be chained into impotence, but possessing warrant never licenses its total release.

activation_trace.role: The hand as effective authority opens the focus beyond money to power capable of enforcement.
An unleashed hand capable of taking, striking, or giving supplies the operational form of authority.
A specific rightful claim establishes that restraint does not cancel legitimate action.
Granted power and jurisdiction supply an authorized hand rather than merely private appetite.
Crossing the limit places an internal boundary inside the exercise of otherwise valid authority.

structural_cues: 17:33 grants authority and then immediately commands that it not cross the limit.
The verse also repeats ج ع ل from the focus, linking the construction of a hand posture with the construction of a legal power.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rightful claim, granted authority, and an explicit no-excess boundary; I project that same architecture onto the focus hand's power branch. The live alternative is that the hand remains exclusively financial and the legal case is only analogous.

changed_reading.before: The hand is a purse whose only variable is how much it spends.
changed_reading.after: The hand is also delegated power: disabling it abandons warranted action, while releasing it without an internal limit converts authority into excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protected property, a maturation horizon, completed covenants, full measure, and a straight balance turn the hand from an absolute owner into an accountable steward. Neither closure nor total release is judged by the holder's feeling alone; both are tested against preservation, timing, and auditable proportion.

activation_trace.role: The possessing hand anchors the assumption that control is real while leaving its moral title open to revision.
Property held and accumulated supplies the asset whose control need not equal beneficial ownership.
A child cut off from a protector supplies the vulnerable claimant for whom another hand must preserve capacity.
Completion without deficiency requires the steward to deliver the whole obligation rather than a self-chosen remainder.
Measured food supplies a concrete audit that replaces vague moderation with countable performance.
The balance of justice makes proportion answerable to an external standard rather than the holder's impulse.
Straightness and equilibrium supply the stable form that bounded circulation seeks.

structural_cues: 17:34 moves from protected property through a future maturity point to a covenant that must be completed.
17:35 follows with full measure and straight weighing, converting moral proportion into an auditable procedure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies another's protected asset, delayed transfer, completion, and just measurement; I infer that the hand may administer what it does not own absolutely. The live alternative is that these are adjacent fiduciary cases rather than a revision of the focus hand.

changed_reading.before: Your hand means your wealth, so moderation balances your generosity against your security.
changed_reading.after: What is in your hand may be entrusted capacity; restraint, release, and timing must preserve another's due and survive measurement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing verse repeats the focus's make-not, causal consequence, and blamed result while relocating the object to ultimate allegiance. Without equating financial excess with association, the frame contains personal agency: the hand is neither sovereign enough to close every claim nor limitless enough to answer every claim by itself.

activation_trace.role: Making something assume a state anchors the focus as a deliberate construction of one's own agency.
Blame supplies the shared evaluative result that the closing frame repeats.
The repeated act of assigning a state opens a structural comparison between constructed hand posture and constructed allegiance.
The worshiped object supplies the ultimate-agency boundary within which personal capacity must remain finite.
Repeated deserved reproach links the consequences without making their offenses identical.
Expulsion and removal intensify the closing consequence and expose the limit of self-constituted agency.

structural_cues: 17:29 has ولا تجعل ... فتقعد ملوما, while 17:39 has ولا تجعل ... فتلقى ... ملوما.
The repeated frame encloses the intervening commands within the passage's final statement about allegiance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated syntax, repeated making, repeated blame, and the final allegiance prohibition; I infer a shared critique of absolutized agency. The materially live alternative is purely rhetorical framing with no semantic transfer from allegiance back to the hand.

changed_reading.before: The verse is an isolated technique for managing a private resource.
changed_reading.after: The verse also disciplines creaturely agency: use real capacity without treating the hand as either an absolute gatekeeper or an inexhaustible source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because كُلَّ in the focus grammatically expresses totality, not fatigue. It remains anchored because the same supplied root inventory carries both totality and blunting, the focus ends in spent strength, and later context repeats totalizing ك ل ل around accountable faculties and acts. Downstream prose should present it only as a root-image echo, never as a lexical replacement for 'all.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The movement from كُلَّ البسط to مَّحْسُورًا.

activation_trace.role: Total inclusion gives the explicit sense of an extension with no reserved part.
Blunting and weariness add a latent shadow in which totalization already tends toward loss of edge and force.
Exhausted capacity realizes the fatigue shadow as the explicit terminal state.
All accountable faculties distribute totality across a continuing field of obligations rather than one exhaustive act.
The passage-wide all gathers the acts for judgment and reinforces the cost of monopolizing all capacity in one release.

changed_reading.before: All extension is only a numerical maximum.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified root echo, totalization carries its own fatigue: spending the whole field of capacity on one act blunts the actor needed for the rest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because 17:37 addresses bodily gait and impossible reach rather than spending. It remains anchored in the focus's fully extended hand and immobilized result, while the later verse supplies failed penetration, failed attainment, and length. Downstream prose should call it a bodily analogy about finite reach, not substitute it for the resource reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The fully extended hand that ends with the actor unable to continue.

activation_trace.role: Length, distance, and the hand's reach turn total extension into a claim about how far agency can go.
Attempted penetration through the earth supplies one impossible fantasy of bodily efficacy.
Reaching a limit supplies the explicit test that the finite body fails.
Length and extension make the mountain comparison a check on fantasies of total personal reach.

changed_reading.before: Extending the hand fully means only spending everything available.
changed_reading.after: It can also dramatize a fantasy that personal reach can be total; depletion is the body's correction of that imagined boundlessness.

strongest_changes: The preceding give-right-disperse sequence turns moderation into ordered fiduciary duty: satisfy claims before preserving reserve.
The immediate expansion-constriction pair makes moderation responsive to variable provision rather than a fixed midpoint.
Scarcity fear reveals why the bound hand can become destructive, while the authority and stewardship cases generalize the hand into bounded, auditable power.
The repeated closing frame contains personal agency under ultimate allegiance without equating resource error with association.
summary.what_was_special: Immediate root and construction recurrences convert a familiar spending maxim into a mechanism of sustainable agency: material transfer, relational continuity, legal power, entrusted property, bodily finitude, and accountability remain distinct but share the need for active capacity with an internal limit.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal result may attach grammatically only to total extension rather than equally to both prohibited postures.
The authority reading is visibly branch-backed but may need to remain secondary to the direct resource sense.
The 17:39 agency frame is a structural resonance, not an equation between spending failure and association.
The fatigue sense of ك ل ل is an exploratory root-image echo and must not be rendered as the lexical meaning of كُلَّ.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The hand must remain mobile between collar and depletion.** `ي د ي:B003/B005/B009` makes hand favor, authority, and act; `غ ل ل:B006` binds a limb by collar; `ب س ط:B001/B004` spreads and releases the hand; `ح س ر:B003/B004` exhausts and grieves over loss. The two bodily extremes terminate in sitting. I infer immobilized withholding and total extension both destroy future agency. The ayah reads moderation as preserving the hand's capacity for repeated giving.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:100's hypothetical withholding from mercy's treasuries magnifies the bound-hand pole; 17:66's gently moved ship supplies the opposite image of controlled release without exhaustion.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Both spending extremes disable future agency.** Lexical evidence: `غ ل ل B006` (a collar binding a limb) in `مَغْلُولَةً`, `ب س ط B004` (extending and releasing the hand) in `تَبْسُطْهَا`, `ق ع د B002` (staying back from action) in `فَتَقْعُدَ`, and `ح س ر B003` (exhausted and depleted) in `مَّحْسُورًا`. Structural cue: 17:26–28 demands targeted help even when it must be deferred, while 17:30 places expansion beside measured restriction. Assigned role: the collar prevents action at the outset; total release exhausts the resource base and produces the same eventual inactivity. Abductive move: the second causal arrow is explicit in `فَتَقْعُدَ`; I infer that preserving a middle capacity is what keeps giving repeatable. Reading change: moderation protects durable agency, because miserliness and depletion converge in an immobilized hand.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:30 made calibrated expansion the immediate model, and 17:34 extended preserved capacity into orphan stewardship; together they confirmed that the middle protects future action.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 (17:23-39): Resource Circulation Between Scattering and Throttling
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material provision must reach its proper recipients without being atomized in waste, immobilized by restraint, or released without measure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Waste becomes seed scattered without cultivation, miserliness becomes a hand chained to the neck, and provision becomes a flow widened or constricted to a measured aperture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Hand Chained to the Neck
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The giving limb is either collared against movement or extended without limit, producing immobility at one extreme and exposed exhaustion at the other.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hand as limb (`quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`); hand as transfer (`quranic:root_001693:B007/m01`); collar that binds an organ (`quranic:root_001102:B006/m01`); neck (`quranic:root_001053:B001/m01`); spreading against contraction (`quranic:root_000116:B001/m01`); unrestricted hand-extension (`quranic:root_000116:B004/m01`); loss of protection (`quranic:root_000320:B002/m01`); exhausted power (`quranic:root_000320:B003/m01`); sitting back from action (`quranic:root_001244:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The verse supplies a stable bodily mechanism for economic conduct. A collar prevents the hand from reaching outward; total extension strips the giver of cover and strength. Both extremes end in seated incapacity, so generosity requires mobile but bounded reach.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tencereyi indirmeye yarayan ısı koruyucu bez ve onunla yapılan eylemle sınırlıdır; ücret anlamındaki benzer biçim buna girmez.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الجعول ولد النعام (maqayis)؛ الجعول الرأل ولد النعام (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, sözün bir yer adı olduğunu açıkça bildirir ve bundan başka bir yer kimliği veya genel anlam vermez. Geçici çerçeve bu sınırlı tanıklığı doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Adın gösterdiği belirli yer açıklanmadığı için tanım bir yer kimliği uydurmaz ve sözü genel yer anlamına dönüştürmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız belirli ad biçimine bağlıdır; genel veya yalın bir yer anlamı olarak genişletilemez.

concept_map.definition: Kaynağın yalnızca bir yer adı olduğunu bildirdiği, gösterdiği yer açıklanmayan özel kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Kimliği belirtilmeyen bir yer için kullanılan özel addır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu kullanım tek bir tanıklıkla sınırlıdır ve yerin kimliğine ilişkin ek bir ortak açıklama bulunmaz.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık sözü bir yer adı olarak sınıflandırır, fakat hangi yeri gösterdiğini açıklamaz.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kaynağın belirli yer kimliğini açıklamadan yalnızca yer adı diye sınıflandırdığı bu özel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yer adı olma bilgisini ve yer kimliğinin belirtilmemiş oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün genel yer anlamı taşımadığı, yalnız özel ad olarak kullanıldığı açıklanırken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sözü kimliği belirtilmemiş özel bir yer adı olarak korur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; adayların her biri başka ve belirli bir yer adını veya genel yer alanını gösterir, ancak odak adın hangi yerle özdeş olduğunu kanıtlamaz; bu yüzden yayımlanabilir bir karşıtlık seçilmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعلة حين يصرح المصدر بأنها اسم مكان.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجعلة الواحدة من النخل الصغار.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجَعْلة اسم مكان (maqayis)

source_note.MQ: Tek tanıklık sözü bir yer adı olarak sınıflandırır, fakat hangi yeri gösterdiğini açıklamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, bir kişide kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenliğin birlikte bulunmasını tek bir betimleyici anlam olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve bu üç kurucu niteliği doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üç nitelik birlikte kurucudur; yalnız kısa, yalnız şişman veya yalnız inatçı olan biri bu dalın tam kapsamına girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın betimleyici kullanıma dayanır ve özel bir söz öbeğiyle sınırlı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişide kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenliğin birlikte bulunmasını anlatan nitelemedir.

facets.statement: Kısa, şişman ve tartışmada inatla direnen kişiyi üç niteliği birlikte taşıyarak betimler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu birleşik kişi betimlemesi tek bir tanıklığa dayanır; kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenlik birlikte verilir.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık üç niteliği ayırmadan kısa, şişman ve inatçı kişi betimlemesinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişide beden kısalığı, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenlik birlikte anlatıldığında tam karşılık verir.

error_profile.preserves: Kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçılığın birlikte bulunması koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üç niteliği birlikte taşıyan bir kişiyi doğal cümle içinde nitelemek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi belirleyen üç kurucu niteliğin tümünü birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Şişmanlık ile tartışmada inatla direnme niteliklerini kısalıkla birlikte gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kalın, güçlü ve toplu beden yapısını bildirir, fakat inatçılığı gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kısa ve toplu beden yapısına sahip kişiyi betimlemede iki dal örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bedensel kısalık ve şişmanlığa davranışsal inatçılığı ekler; komşu dal ise bedensel kalınlık ve gücü öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kısalık ve inatçı çekişkenliği şişmanlıkla birlikte zorunlu kılar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan veya hayvanda bedenin dolgunlaşıp yağlanmasını anlatır, boy ve huy koşulu taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Şişmanlık ve beden dolgunluğu anlam alanında iki dal buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal üçlü bir kişi niteliğidir; komşu dal yalnız bedensel dolgunluğu seçer ve farklı canlı türlerine de uygulanabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; kısa ve toplu kişi betimi ile genel beden dolgunluğu, üç niteliğin birlikte bulunması koşulunu en açık biçimde ayırır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعل بمعنى اجتماع القصر والسمن واللجاج في وصف الشخص.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه قصر النخل ولا الدويبة المسماة جعلا.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجعل القصر مع السمن واللجاج (tahdhib)

source_note.TA: Tek tanıklık üç niteliği ayırmadan kısa, şişman ve inatçı kişi betimlemesinde birleştirir.

root_profile.summary: Kök, bir şeyi var etme, bir duruma sokma, adlandırma ve eyleme başlama gibi eylem anlamlarından; iş karşılığı, küçük hurma ağacı, tencere bezi, küçük yer hayvanı, dişinin eş istemesi, deve kuşu yavrusu, yer adı ve birleşik kişi betimi gibi birbirinden uzak ad alanlarına yayılır. Bu dallar tek bir çağdaş çekirdeğe indirgenemeyen belirgin bir çok anlamlılık oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, beden organı olan eli merkez alır ve bu organın vurulması, kesilmesi, ağrıması ya da tuzağa yakalanmasıyla ilgili türevleri aynı dalda toplar. Bu nedenle dalın bedensel el olarak kurulması kaynak kapsamını doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca beden organını ve doğrudan bu organın başına gelen durumları kapsar; güç, iyilik ya da sahiplik anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, beden organını temel anlam olarak korur; vurma, kesilme, ağrı ve tuzağa yakalanma anlamlarını ayrı türemiş ya da özel kullanımlar olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: İnsan bedenindeki el ile bu organın vurulması, kesilmesi, ağrıması veya bir tuzağa yakalanması sonucunda ortaya çıkan durumları anlatır.

facets.statement: Temel gönderim, insan bedenindeki el organıdır.
Elin vurulması, yaralanması, kökünden kesilmesi ve ağrıması bu bedensel çekirdekten türeyen durumlardır.
Bir tuzağın eli yakalaması da özel bir el durumu olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar el organında birleşir; ayrıca ele vurmayı, eli kesilmiş kişiyi, el ağrısını ve elin tuzağa yakalanmasını bu çekirdeğe bağlı biçimlerde kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: el ve elin uğradığı bedensel durumlar
concept_gloss.applicability: Beden organını ve bu organın vurulma, kesilme, ağrıma ya da yakalanma durumlarını birlikte özetler.

error_profile.preserves: Beden organını ve ona doğrudan yönelen durumları korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğrudan beden organından söz edilen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Beden organı olan temel anlamı eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Elin darbe alması veya kesilmesiyle oluşan kişi durumunu anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: El organındaki yaralanma veya kesilme sonucunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bütün el organını ve elin yaralanma, kesilme, ağrıma ya da yakalanma durumlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Avuç içini ve parmaklarla birlikte kavrayıp açılan el bölümünü özel olarak anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da üst uzvun el bölgesini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bütün eli ve bu organa ilişkin durumları kapsarken komşu dal elin avuç ve parmaklarla kavrayan bölümüne yönelir; bu yüzden birbirlerinin yerine genel olarak kullanılamazlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tek bir organ olarak eli ve o organa doğrudan gelen zararları anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: El ve ayakların yanı sıra başı, deriyi ve öldürücü olmayan başka beden bölgelerini de topluca kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bedensel organlar ve bu organların zarar görmesi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği eldir; komşu dal ise çok sayıda beden ucunu ve öldürücü olmayan hedef bölgesini sınıflandıran daha geniş bir alandır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; elin kendi iç bölümü ve daha geniş beden-uçları alanı sınırı en iyi açıklayan iki karşılaştırma olarak seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: اليَد العضو وما يتصل بإصابته أو قطعه أو وجعه أو وقوعه في حبالة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس القوة ولا النعمة ولا الملك
branches.source_phrase_ar: اليَد الجارحة (mufradat)؛ اليد أصلها يدي وجمعها أيد ويدي (sihah)؛ يديت الرجل إذا ضربت يده (jamhara;sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ رجل ميدي أي مقطوع اليد واليداء وجع اليد (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi eli açıkça güç, yeterlik ve birini güçlendirme anlamlarıyla ilişkilendirir; ayrıca bir şeye gücün yetmediğini bildiren özel sözü içerir. Dalın güç çevresinde kurulması bu ortak çekirdeği doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki el beden organı değildir; güç, bir işi yapabilme yeterliği ve gücü artırma anlamlarıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım güç çekirdeğini korur, güçlendirme türevini ve gücü yetmeme sözünü ayrı kullanımlar olarak gösterir; özel sözün kapsamını yalın biçime yaymaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi yapmaya yarayan güç ve yeterliği, bu gücün artırılmasını ya da belirli bir iş karşısında gücün yetmemesini anlatır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, güç ve bir işi yapabilme yeterliğidir.
Birini güçlendirmek, çekirdek gücün başkasında artırılmasıdır.
Özel bir söz, belirli bir kişiye ya da işe karşı gücün yetmediğini bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar el ve ona bağlı biçimlerde güç ile yeterlik anlamını ortaklaştırır; güçlendirme eylemini ve gücü yetmeme sözünü de aynı anlam alanına bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Güç sahibi olma, bir işe gücü yetme ve başkasının gücünü artırma çekirdeğini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Güç, yeterlik ve gücü artırma ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işi yapabilme gücünden veya genel yeterlikten söz edilen yerlerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güç ve yapabilme yeterliği çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir kişi, iş ya da durum karşısında yeterli gücün bulunmadığı sözlerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir şeye karşı yetersizlik anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: El üzerinden anlatılan güç, güçlendirme ve gücü yetmeme kullanımlarını bir arada kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Güç ve yeterliği başka bir özel söz ailesi içinde adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın çekirdeğinde bir işi yapabilme gücü ve yeterliği vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekler büyük ölçüde örtüşür; ancak odak dal el imgesine bağlı güçlendirme ve gücü yetmeme kullanımlarına uzanırken komşu dal kendi özel söz alanıyla sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; güç ve yeterlik çekirdeğini doğrudan paylaşan aday yayımlandı, yalnızca uzak alan benzerliği taşıyanlar elendi.
branches.what_is_ar: القوة والقدرة والطاقة التي يعبر عنها باليد والأيد
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الجارحة ولا النعمة ولا الملك
branches.source_phrase_ar: اليد القوة وأيده أي قواه (sihah)؛ ما لي به يدان أي قوة (tahdhib;mufradat)؛ أولي الأيدي أي أولي القوة (tahdhib;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi eli, başkasına sunulan iyilik ve karşılıksız verme olarak açıklar; borç, satış veya karşılık olmadan yapılan verme bu çekirdeğin özel sınırını belirler. Dalın iyilik ve bağış çevresinde kurulması kaynağa uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, başkasına sağlanan iyilik ve karşılıksız vermeyle sınırlıdır; sahiplik, güç ya da alışverişteki karşılıklı ödeme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım iyilik çekirdeğini, iyilikte bulunma eylemini ve borç ya da değiş tokuş olmayan karşılıksız verme sözünü birbirinden ayırarak korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir başkasına iyilik sağlama ve ona karşılık, borç ya da satış ilişkisi olmadan mal veya yarar verme anlamını taşır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, başkasına sağlanan iyilik ve yarardır.
İyilikte bulunmak, bu yararın bir başkasına ulaştırılmasıdır.
Özel verme biçimi, satış, borç veya karşılık olmaksızın gönüllü vermeyi belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar eli iyilik ve yarar sağlama anlamında birleştirir; birine iyilik etmeyi ve herhangi bir değiş tokuş ya da geri ödeme beklemeden vermeyi bu çekirdeğin açık uygulamaları sayar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Birine yarar sağlama ile borç veya değiş tokuş olmayan gönüllü vermeyi birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: İyilik sağlama ve karşılıksız verme sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye yarar sağlama veya onun işini kolaylaştırma bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasına yarar sağlama eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Verilen şeyin satış, borç ya da karşılık sayılmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Geri ödeme ve değiş tokuş bulunmayan verme biçimini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: satış, borç ya da karşılık olmadan vermek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: El imgesiyle başkasına sunulan iyiliği ve özellikle karşılıksız vermeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İyi durumda olmayı, rahat yaşamı ve kişiye ulaştırılan iyiliği daha geniş bir alan içinde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişiye ulaşan iyilik, yarar ve verme anlamlarını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal başkasına yapılan iyilik ve karşılıksız verme eylemine yönelir; komşu dal ise iyi durumda olma ve rahat yaşamı da içine alan daha geniş bir anlam alanına sahiptir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; hem iyilik hem verme yönünü paylaşan en yakın aday seçildi, yalnız cömertlik veya yalnız yoksunluk bildirenler yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: النعمة والإحسان واليد التي تسدى إلى غيرك والعطاء تفضلا
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الملك ولا القوة ولا المعاوضة يدا بيد
branches.source_phrase_ar: أيديت إلى الرجل يدا إذا أسديتها إليه (jamhara)؛ اليد النعمة والإحسان (sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ أعطاه مالا عن ظهر يد تفضلا ليس من قرض ولا مكافأة (sihah;tahdhib)؛ يده مطلقة عبارة عن إيتاء النعيم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir şeyin birinin elinde bulunmasını onun malı ve denetimi altında olması diye açıklar. Dalın sahiplik ve elde bulundurma olarak kurulması bu özel sözün anlamını doğru verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca bir şeyin birinin elinde bulunduğunu söyleyen yapıda ortaya çıkar; yalın el sözcüğüne genel bir sahiplik anlamı yüklenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, sahiplik ve denetim anlamını yalnızca bir şeyin birinin elinde bulunduğunu bildiren yapıya bağlar ve bunu yalın kök anlamına genellemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin belirli bir kişinin elinde bulunması sözünde, o şeyin onun sahipliği, koruması veya denetimi altında olmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin kişiye ait olması ve onun elinde tutulması çekirdek anlamdır.
Sahipliğe eşlik eden kullanma ve yönetme yetkisi de bu sözün kapsamındadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir şeyin bir kişinin elinde olduğunu söyleyen yapıyı o kişinin sahipliği ve denetimi altında bulunma biçiminde ortak olarak açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye ait ve onun yönetimi altında olduğunu bildiren yapının tamamına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sahiplik ile fiili denetimin birlikte bulunmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir malın veya yerin belirli bir kişinin sahipliği altında olduğunu söyleyen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Elde bulundurma, sahiplik ve denetim birlikteliğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sahipliği, bir şeyin belirli bir kişinin elinde bulunduğunu söyleyen özel yapı üzerinden anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Mal edinme, bir şeyi başkasına mal etme, yönetme ve sahip olunan kişi ya da şeyler gibi daha geniş sahiplik ilişkilerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin kişiye ait olması ve onun yönetiminde bulunması anlamını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnızca elinde bulunma yapısındaki sahipliği bildirir; komşu dal ise sahip olma ve yönetme alanının yalın ve daha geniş anlatımıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; sahiplik ile denetimi birlikte taşıyan aday en açıklayıcı karşılaştırma olarak yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: الحوز والملك وما يكون في يد المرء أو تحت تصرفه
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس النعمة ولا الذل والاستسلام
branches.source_phrase_ar: هذا الشيء في يدي أي في ملكي (sihah)؛ هذه الضيعة في يد فلان أي ملكه (tahdhib)؛ للحوز والملك يقال هذا في يد فلان (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi eli egemenlik, sözü geçen buyruk ve üstün gelme gücü olarak açıklar; rüzgara bağlanan kullanım da yön verici gücü anlatır. Dalın egemenlik çevresindeki kimliği bu kanıtla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal salt fiziksel güç veya sahiplik değildir; başkasına ya da bir sürece yön veren, sözü geçen üstün gücü anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel egemenlik anlamını korur ve rüzgara yön verme gücü yükleyen özel sözü ayrı bir uygulama olarak sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi veya gücün başkaları üzerinde sözü geçecek biçimde üstün olması, buyruk yürütmesi ve bir sürecin yönünü belirlemesi anlamını taşır.

facets.statement: Egemenlik, geçerli buyruk ve üstün gelme gücü çekirdeği oluşturur.
Rüzgarın eli sözü, rüzgarın yön verme ve sürükleme gücünü bu çekirdeğe bağlar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar eli egemenlik, sözü geçen buyruk ve üstünlük olarak açıklar; bir rüzgarın yön verici gücü de aynı üstün etki imgesiyle anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözü geçen üstün gücü, buyruk yürütmeyi ve yön verici etkiyi birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Egemenlik, geçerli buyruk ve yön verme gücünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin ya da tarafın buyruğunun geçerli olduğu üstünlük bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sözü geçme ve üstün gelme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Rüzgar gibi bir gücün hareketi yönlendirmesi veya sürüklemesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir sürece yön veren üstün etkiyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sözü geçen buyruk, üstün el ve rüzgarın yön verici gücü gibi el imgesine bağlı kullanımları içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Birini baskı altında tutabilme ve zorlayıcı güçle egemen olma yeterliğini doğrudan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da başkaları üzerinde üstün ve yön verici güç kurmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal geçerli buyruk ve üstün konum üzerinde durur; komşu dal ise özellikle zorlama ve baskı kurabilme gücünü öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; egemenlik ve zorlayıcı güç sınırını en açık gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız yöneticilik unvanı taşıyanlar elendi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ana bölümü boyun eğme, buyruğa girme ve bağlılıktan çıkma çevresindedir; ancak güvence verme ve yükümlülük üstlenme sözü de aynı dalda yer alır. Dal korunabilir, fakat güvence kullanımı boyun eğmenin eş anlamı değil, ayrı bir sözleşme yönü olarak gösterilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Boyun eğme çekirdeği ile güvence verme kullanımı ayrı tutulur; bunlar tek bir genel el anlamı gibi birleştirilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım boyun eğme çekirdeğini korur; buyruğa girme, güvence verme ve bağlılıktan çıkma yapılarını kendi sınırları içinde ayrı ayrı açıklar.

concept_map.definition: Belirli el sözlerinde birinin buyruğuna girip boyun eğmeyi veya bu bağlılıktan çıkmayı anlatır. Başka bir özel sözde ise bir yükümlülüğü üstlenerek güvence vermeyi bildirir.

facets.statement: Birinin buyruğuna girme, ona uyma ve boyun eğme ana anlamdır.
Eli güvence sayan söz, bir borç veya yükümlülüğü üstlenme bildirimidir.
Eli bağlılıktan çekme sözü, buyruğa uymayı bırakıp bağdan çıkmayı anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt el üzerinden boyun eğme ve buyruğa girmeyi, buna karşılık bağlılıktan çıkmayı ve ayrı bir özel sözde güvence üstlenmeyi birlikte kaydeder; güvence yönü ana boyun eğme anlamından ayrıdır.

concept_gloss.text: boyun eğme, bağlılık ve güvence üstlenme
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın buyruğa girme çekirdeğini, bağlılıktan çıkma karşı yönünü ve ayrı güvence kullanımını birlikte özetler.

error_profile.preserves: Boyun eğme ile güvence üstlenme yönlerini ayrı tutarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin hükmünü kabul etme ve ona uyma bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Buyruğa girme ve boyun eğme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir borç ya da işi üstlendiğini eldeki güvenceyle bildiren özel söz için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yükümlülüğü üstlenme ve güvence verme anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Boyun eğmeyi, uymayı ve kolay yönetilen bir canlının yumuşak başlılığını doğrudan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir buyruğu kabul ederek ona uyma ve boyun eğme çekirdeğini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli el sözlerindeki bağlılık, güvence ve bağdan çıkma yönlerine uzanır; komşu dal ise boyun eğme davranışını daha doğrudan ve daha geniş örneklerle adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Güvence yönünün yanında buyruğa girme ve bağlılıktan çıkma anlamlarını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir yükümlülüğün ödenmesini üstlenen kişi ve bu üstlenmenin topluluk içindeki biçimlerini doğrudan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir iş veya borç için sorumluluk ve güvence üstlenmeyi anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Güvence, odak dalın yalnızca özel bir yanıdır; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise doğrudan yükümlülüğü üstlenme ve bunu yerine getirme sorumluluğudur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; dalın iki ayrı yönünü açıklayan boyun eğme ve güvence adayları seçildi, yalnız uzak bağlılık çağrışımı taşıyanlar elendi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi doğrudan elden ele verme, karşılığını aynı anda ödeme ve vadeye bırakmama yönlerini açıkça destekler. İki ayrı fiyatla satış ise aynı ticaret çevresinde fakat farklı bir özel kullanım olduğundan, dal korunurken doğrudan el değişimi çekirdeğiyle özdeşleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Elden ele verme ve peşinlik ana işlem yönüdür; iki fiyatlı satış ayrı bir yapı olarak tutulur ve yalın el anlamına yayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan elden verme, peşin ödeme ve karşılık verme kullanımlarını ayırır; iki fiyatlı satış yapısını ayrıca sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin veya karşılığının elden ele doğrudan verilmesini ve ödemenin vadeye bırakılmadan yapılmasını anlatır. Ayrı bir satış sözünde iki farklı fiyatı ya da mal ile bedelin eş zamanlı el değiştirmesini bildirir.

facets.statement: Malın veya karşılığın bir elden ötekine doğrudan geçirilmesi çekirdek işlemdir.
Ödemenin hemen ve peşin yapılması, doğrudan el değişiminin zaman sınırıdır.
Özel satış sözü iki farklı fiyatı veya mal ile bedelin aynı anda karşılıklı verilmesini anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt elden ele verme, doğrudan karşılık ödeme ve peşinliği aynı işlem alanında toplar; iki elli satış sözü ise iki fiyat ya da eş zamanlı mal-bedel değişimi olarak ayrıca açıklanır.

concept_gloss.text: elden ele verme, peşin ödeme ve iki fiyatlı satış
concept_gloss.applicability: Doğrudan aktarım ile peşin karşılığı ve ayrı iki fiyatlı satış kullanımını birlikte, fakat ayrımlarını koruyarak özetler.

error_profile.preserves: Doğrudan aktarım, peşinlik ve iki fiyatlı satış ayrımını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Ödemenin ertelenmeden yapılması sınırını korur.
